content: Self-hosted Docker Compose apps should minimize service count for reliable out-of-the-box deploy. Common comparable pattern (Docmost/Outline): app container(s) + Postgres + Redis + object storage. Given Skillshare's small file sizes (markdown+resources) and 'must work out of the box, no complex infra' constraint, default to local filesystem storage + Postgres-backed job queue (pg-boss) to avoid Redis/object-storage containers in v1; add pluggable S3-compatible storage driver for later cloud/SaaS mode.
